question: What must an Express Entry arranged-employment job-offer letter contain?

claims.text: A letter from the employer(s) offering the job in Canada is required
claims.quote: A letter from the employer(s) offering the job in Canada is required

basis: The applicant uploaded a document under the written_job_offer_lmia slot for case ID 5ef2ea9721515c97ebb4b2fba32dc636.
The file 5ef2ea9721515c97ebb4b2fba32dc636.pdf is a 2-page PDF document comprised of rasterized image objects.
The generic requirement for a job offer letter applies when an applicant claims arranged employment points.
prose: An arranged-employment job-offer letter for Express Entry must be a letter from the employer offering the job in Canada, printed on company letterhead, specifying the job details and continuous full-time employment terms.
